Maya (PM): Wanted to get quick feedback on the prompt-sets/evals Run UI. Main problems: long diffs push scorecard offscreen, users can't easily bulk-select via keyboard, and the approval copy is ambiguous. Thoughts?

Ravi (Designer): Uploaded new mock. Proposal: persistent left filter rail + compact list view. Each diff row has a small chevron to expand inline. Compact mode hides secondary metadata and shows score chips.

Evan (Eng): Compact + inline expand is doable, but we must virtualize the list for runs >1000 rows. Challenge: keep expanded state when rows are recycled. Suggest storing expanded ids in client store and rehydrating after virtualization.

Lina (Frontend): Keyboard patterns: Enter/Space to toggle expand, Shift+Arrow for range select, and 'f' to focus the filter input. For single-item approve, use an inline dropdown confirm rather than a modal to reduce context switching.

Tess (A11y): A11y notes: 1) Announce selection counts via aria-live when range select used. 2) Approve controls must include accessible names (e.g., "Approve evaluation 9876"). 3) Ensure tooltip/legend for scorecard is keyboard-focusable and visible on focus. 4) Fix contrast for muted score chips (<4.5:1).

Nadia (ProdEng): Analytics: send events 'compact_mode_toggled','range_select_started','range_select_confirmed','inline_approve_shown','bulk_approve_confirmed'. Include run_id, promptset_id, user_id, selected_count. Bulk API should return 'undo_token' and 'undo_window_ms'.

Maya (PM): Copy for bulk confirm suggestion: "Approve 8 evaluations — these will be marked as accepted for Run #2001. You can undo this action for 5 minutes." Preference for clarity.

Ravi (Designer): I'll shorten slightly: "Approve 8 evaluations — marked accepted for Run #2001. Undo available for 5 minutes." Will add inline help link 'How undo works'.

Evan (Eng): Backend: bulk-approve must be idempotent. Undo should enqueue a reverse job; use messaging so partial failures can be reconciled. Return optimistic_state_id to front-end.

Lina (Frontend): Implementation tasks: keyboard handlers, range-select overlay (shows "Selecting 3 items — Enter to confirm"), inline confirm component, and store density preference. Will add unit tests for focus management.

Tess (A11y): I'll draft an a11y test script for NVDA/VoiceOver and checklist for PR review.

Nadia (ProdEng): I'll publish the analytics schema and example payloads in the tracking PR.

Maya (PM): Decisions: 1) compact mode persisted per-user, 2) inline expand + virtualization with expanded-state store, 3) range-select keyboard (Shift+Arrow) + 'a' select-all, 4) inline confirm for single-item approves, full modal for bulk, 5) bulk confirm copy as Ravi's variant with docs link, 6) a11y fixes and analytics events.

Ravi (Designer): Pushing updated Figma with tooltip and inline confirm.

Evan (Eng): Opening infra ticket for idempotency and undo pipeline.

Lina (Frontend): Will start feature branch and keep UX small for early testing.

Tess (A11y): Will review prototype pre-signoff.

Maya (PM): Thanks all. Sync on Monday to finalize. :thumbsup:
